entry.buy_limit: IOC limit preserving minimum net U headroom
entry.fill: next legal one-minute open strictly after trigger
entry.trigger: first completed one-minute close >= L on exact first-return day

exit.failure: first completed sellable-session daily close below L; exit next legal open
exit.target: legal U realization, no earlier than T+1
exit.time_stop: H10 close information; exit next legal open

fixed_simple_rule.condition_1: maximum pre-gap VAP mass in any 0.10W bin of z=[-0.5,1.5) <=2.5 times mean bin mass in z=[-2,3)
fixed_simple_rule.condition_2: 120-session reference peak is at least 60 sessions before gap
fixed_simple_rule.condition_3: pre-gap 20-session coordinate high-low range <=20%; this is a range/non-acute condition, not a chronological run-up statistic
fixed_simple_rule.condition_4: entry retains at least 1.5% net target headroom after 40 bp
fixed_simple_rule.threshold_origin: chosen after already-consumed 2014-2020 Development and chart review; frozen before 2021 outcomes; no retrospective OOF claim

scientific_role: development-informed fixed-rule reconstruction plus one-shot previously unread 2021 outcome confirmation

source.confirmation_gap_cohort: all governed 2014-2021 gaps whose first exact raw-fen return occurs in 2021
source.population: all governed Main/ChiNext downward true gaps
source.raw_tick_interaction: floor(raw_price*100+0.5+1e-6) compared with the mapped QD-010 coordinate boundary in raw fen

validation_gate.interpretation: one-year confirmation only, never final external validation
